ability.name: Staunch Defender
ability.effect: While this unit is contesting an objective in friendly territory, add 3 to the control scores of friendly **^^Stormcast Eternals^^** units contesting that objective.

ability.name: Envoy of the Heavens
ability.effect: The target has **^^Ward (5+)^^** until the start of your next turn.
ability.declare: If a friendly **^^Stormcast Eternals^^** unit was destroyed in the previous turn, pick a visible friendly **^^Stormcast Eternals^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

ability.name: Shock and Awe
ability.effect:
Each time this unit is set up using the ’Scions of the Storm’ ability, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target this unit for the rest of the battle round.
In addition, each time a friendly **^^Stormcast Eternals^^** unit is set up wholly within 12" of this unit using the ‘Scions of the Storm’ ability, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target that unit for the rest of the battle round.

ability.name: Intense Piety
ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 1 from casting rolls and chanting rolls for the target until the start of your next turn.
ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy **^^Priest^^** or **^^Wizard^^** within 18" of this unit to be the target.

ability.name: Legendary Tenacity
ability.effect: The first time this unit would be destroyed, before removing it from play, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit is not destroyed and any remaining damage points inflicted on it have no effect. Then, **Heal (D3)** this unit.

ability.name: Hour of Glory
ability.effect: This unit can be picked to use the ‘Their Finest Hour’ ability even if it has already used it this battle. In addition, when this unit is picked to use the ‘Their Finest Hour’ ability, add 5 to its control score for the rest of the turn.
